lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: By nine, green smoke boiled from the Horsell pit while the offensive gathered.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Three machines crossed the evening country, spaced apart, their howls linking the distant roads.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: At Ripley, frightened volunteers fired early, scattered on foot, and left the guns exposed.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: One machine crossed the abandoned pieces and reached Painshill Park, where the battery vanished.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The pine battery waited under cover.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Disciplined hands set a deliberate range.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Shells struck around the Martian; its frame buckled, and a second giant rose beyond the trees.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Heat rays swept the battery, turning ammunition and pines into a single burning answer.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Three machines gathered counsel, then one damaged support received patient work beneath its hood.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Four more joined them, and seven black tubes marked a curved frontier across Surrey.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Twelve rockets warned the waiting guns as armed machines crossed the river into mist.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: I draw the curate into cover; his fear changes our route from flight to watching.

lines.speaker: curate
lines.text: What has happened?

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Heaven knows!

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The nearer machine left the riverbank; across the fields, black hills began to rise.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: From the hedge we watched those vapour summits spread, while distant artillery lost its voice.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: The canisters struck earth and opened into heavy vapour, flowing through valleys and ditches.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: High above Street Cobham, a stranded witness saw roofs and trees emerge above the black flow.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: At Esher, the waiting order of guns met a cone of vapour, smoke, and falling men.

lines.speaker: unnamed_first_person_narrator
lines.text: Before dawn, Richmond filled with black vapour, while organised resistance broke across the country.

lines.speaker: curate
lines.text: The guns are silent.
